title: Stretched Systems
items: An extended HA method supported by SAN Volume Controller that continues I/O after the loss of half the system
A system with more than four I/O groups
Stretched System 是 SAN Volume Controller 支援的延伸 HA 方式，失去一半系統後仍可繼續 I/O。
Why is a stretched system sometimes called a split system?
One half of the system and I/O group is usually at a distant location, often 10 km or more
It splits volumes into two halves
It splits the GUI into two views
因一半的系統與 I/O Group 通常位於遠端 (常達 10 公里以上)，所以又稱 Split System。
What must the third site host in a stretched system?
A storage system that provides a quorum disk (or an IP quorum application)
A third node of each I/O group
第三站點須提供 Quorum Disk 或 IP Quorum，在兩主站點連線失效時自動仲裁。
What additional capability does an enhanced stretched system provide over automatic site failover?
A manual override to choose which of two sites continues operation
Enhanced Stretched System 除自動 Failover 外，還提供手動覆寫以決定哪個站點繼續運作。
How does an enhanced stretched system reduce inter-site traffic?
It intelligently routes I/O between nodes and controllers
Enhanced Stretched System 智慧導引 Node 與 Controller 間的 I/O，減少跨站流量並降低 Host Latency。
In an enhanced stretched system, which objects must have the site attribute set?
Enhanced Stretched System 須在 Node 與 Controller 物件設定 site 屬性。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch13 Note
How is each site defined in a stretched system configuration?
每個站點定義為獨立 Failure Domain，一個站點故障時另一站點可不中斷繼續運作。
Which can be considered separate sites in a stretched configuration?
Different power phases in one data center, buildings on a campus, or different cities
Only different racks on the same power phase
Only different floors with shared power
站點可以是同一資料中心內不同電力相位 (例如兩個 Rack)、同園區不同建築或不同城市。
What is the key prerequisite for a stretched system to continue operating after the loss of one site?
Each site contains only one node from each pair of nodes, with mirroring configured
All storage is at one site
Hosts are at the third site
每個站點只能放每對 Node 中的一個，且必須搭配適當的 Mirroring 技術，才能真正提供 HA。
Which host connection type is NOT supported in stretched system configurations?
Stretched 環境支援 FC 與 iSCSI Host 連線，但不支援以 NVMe 為基礎的 Host 連線。
Ethernet connections between nodes in a stretched system are supported only through which adapters?
Node 之間的 Ethernet 連線只能透過各 Node 安裝並設定的 RDMA-capable 介面卡。
For 4-node stretched SVC clusters without volume mirroring, how does IBM recommend upgrading?
Using the manual software upgrade procedure
這類 Configuration 可能因重新探索 Backend 的 Race Condition 導致升級卡住，IBM 建議使用手動升級程序。
Can a stretched system guarantee continuous operation after the failure of two failure domains?
Stretched System 設計為失去一個 Failure Domain 後繼續運作，無法保證兩個 Failure Domain 失效後仍持續。
Which CLI command assigns a node to a site?
以 `chnode` 指派 Node 的 Site，`chcontroller` 指派後端儲存，`chhost` 指派 Host。
簡報 S8；Concept Guide Ch13 Configuration steps
When is the enhanced mode enabled?
After all nodes, hosts, and storage systems are assigned to sites, by changing the system topology to stretched
所有 Node、Host 與儲存系統都指派站點後，將 System Topology 改為 stretched 即啟用 Enhanced 模式。
What can additional nodes cabled to a stretched system be configured as?
額外佈線的 Node 可設定為 Hot-spare Node，在站點中任一 Node 不可用時不中斷接手 Host I/O。
Which statement about planning a stretched topology is correct?
Each node of an I/O group must be at a different site
Both nodes of an I/O group must be at the same site
Quorum MDisks must be at the primary site
同一 I/O Group 的每個 Node 必須位於不同站點，每個站點都要有 MDisk，第三站點要有 Quorum 用 MDisk。
What must be set for each controller before the topology can be set to stretched?
每個 Controller 必須先設定 site 為 1、2 或 3，才可將 Topology 設為 stretched。
Are expansion enclosures supported with stretched system topology?
Stretched System Topology 不支援 Expansion Enclosure。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch13 Note
Nodes in the same I/O group separated by more than what distance must use longwave Fibre Channel?
同一 I/O Group 的 Node 相距超過 100 公尺 (109 碼) 時須使用 Longwave Fibre Channel。
How many SAN fabrics should each node be directly connected to at the primary and secondary sites?
每個 Node 直接連到主要與次要站點的 2 至 8 個 SAN Fabric；iSCSI 則連到兩個以上 Ethernet Fabric。
What should be avoided in paths between nodes and external storage systems?
應避免在 Node 與外部儲存之間的路徑使用 ISL；若無法避免則不可過度訂閱並通常需 Trunking。
For which models are stretched systems NOT recommended?
Models that support nodes with internal flash drives
具內部 Flash Drive Node 的型號不建議使用 Stretched System。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch13 Notes
How can quorum be accessed in a stretched system?
Only through the current owner of the MDisk used as the active quorum disk
Through any node at any time
Stretched System 的 Quorum 只能經由作用中 Quorum MDisk 目前的擁有者存取。
What must a storage system at the third site support?
第三站點的儲存系統必須支援 Extended Quorum Disk。
Where should the preferred node of each volume be set, where possible?
To the node in the same site as the host the volume is mapped to
To the node at the third site
盡量將每個 Volume 的 Preferred Node 設為與映射 Host 同一站點的 Node。
Why is a single switch at the third site a problem?
It can create a single fabric instead of two independent fabrics, which is unsupported
第三站點只用一台 Switch 可能形成單一 Fabric 而非兩個獨立冗餘 Fabric，單一 Fabric 不受支援。
How should Ethernet port 1 on every node in a stretched system be connected?
To the same subnet or subnets
每個 Node 的 Ethernet Port 1 須接到相同子網路，Port 2 亦同 (可與 Port 1 不同)。
When are IP quorum applications used in a stretched system?
When the stretched system connects to iSCSI-attached storage systems
Never; only quorum disks are allowed
Only when there are more than 8 nodes
Stretched System 連接 iSCSI 儲存時使用 IP Quorum Application；iSCSI 儲存不能設在第三站點。
If communication is lost between the primary and secondary sites, which site continues processing?
The site with access to the active quorum disk
The site with the configuration node
兩主站點斷線時，能存取作用中 Quorum Disk 的站點繼續處理交易。
How many quorum disks can be elected to resolve a partition into two equal sets of nodes?
系統最多可設定三個 Quorum Disk，但只有一個會被選來解決兩半相等的分裂情況，其他提供冗餘。
What is a restriction on connecting storage systems in a stretched configuration?
Do not connect a storage system in one site directly to a switch fabric in the other site
Storage must connect to all fabrics in both sites
Storage must connect only to the third site
不可將一個站點的儲存直接接到另一站點的 Switch Fabric，儲存只接本地站點 Switch。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch13 Restriction
Above what cable distance between production sites can ISL-based configurations see performance impacts?
使用 ISL 時，若兩生產站點間纜線距離超過 100 km 可能影響效能。
When using ISLs for node-to-node communication, what SAN design is required?
Two SANs, each with two redundant fabrics: a private SAN for node-to-node and a public SAN for hosts and storage
A single private fabric shared with hosts
使用 ISL 需建立兩套 SAN，各含兩個冗餘 Fabric：Private SAN 供 Node 間通訊，Public SAN 供 Host 與儲存。
When using two dark fibre links for ISLs, how should fabrics be assigned?
Dedicate one link to each fabric; do not cross-connect
Put both fabrics on one link
Cross-connect both fabrics on both links
Use one link and keep the other idle
兩條 Dark Fibre 時每條專用於一個 Fabric，不要把兩個 Fabric 交叉接到兩條鏈路上。
In an enhanced stretched system with ISLs, how should storage systems configured to site 1 or 2 be zoned?
Only to be visible by the nodes in that site
To all nodes at all sites
Enhanced Configuration 中，Site 1 或 2 的儲存只需 Zone 給該站點 Node；Site 3 或未定義站點的儲存則要 Zone 給所有 Node。
For configurations without ISLs, what is the minimum switch requirement per site?
At least one switch per site forming two independent fabrics; a single fabric is not supported
不使用 ISL 時每站點至少一台 Switch 構成兩個獨立 Fabric，最高可靠度為每站點兩台；不支援單一 Fabric。
Which extenders can be used in configurations without ISLs?
不使用 ISL 時可用 DWDM 等主動式延伸器；Node 間不支援 FCIP。
Where in the GUI do you configure an enhanced stretched system?
Monitoring > System > System Actions > Modify System Topology
GUI 路徑為 Monitoring > System > System Actions > Modify System Topology，精靈引導完成站點定義。
During the Modify System Topology wizard, which storage must be added manually?
精靈會自動偵測 FC 儲存，iSCSI 儲存須手動加入。
Can site 3 be assigned to a node?
No, site 3 contains only external storage for quorum
Site 3 不可指派給 Node，只包含 Quorum 用的外部儲存。
Which commands add iSCSI storage ports with a site in a stretched system?
iSCSI 儲存以 `detectiscsistorageportcandidate`、`addiscsistorageport` 並指定 -site 加入。
Events whose impact gradually spreads over a longer time
Rolling Disaster 指事件影響逐步擴大且歷時較長，例如站點間鏈路先失效，之後取得 Quorum 的站點也失效。
In a rolling disaster, which node error appears when the remaining site's MDisks stop?
另一站點的 MDisk 停止時，Node 顯示錯誤 551。
Who must assist when using the manual quorum override?
Quorum Override 只能在 Support 協助下執行。
What is required before the quorum override command is available?
chsystem -topology stretched must have been run
需先執行 `chsystem -topology stretched`，Quorum Override 指令才可使用。
What does the quorum override process do?
Elects a new quorum and creates a new system from the remaining site's nodes
Swaps the primary and secondary sites permanently
以 Quorum Override 指令改選新 Quorum，並以剩餘站點的 Node 建立新系統。
Some nodes show error 550 due to a fabric outage during override. What should be done?
Run the override again on a node that shows 551
Fabric 中斷可能使部分 Node 顯示 550，可在顯示 551 的 Node 上再執行一次。
What do quorum disks and IP quorum applications contain in addition to providing a tie-break?
Configuration metadata used to recover the system
Quorum Disk 與 IP Quorum Application 都含有可用於復原系統的 Configuration Metadata。
When used with volume mirroring, what does the third-site quorum stretched configuration tolerate?
A failure at a single site
搭配 Volume Mirroring，此 Configuration 可容忍單一站點失效，剩餘站點繼續 I/O。
